shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -name package-lock.json -print && cat package.json

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/products.ts app/*.tsx app/globals.css "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx"; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules | head -50; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd /workspace; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace; grep -o "exports\.\(unstable_\)\?ViewTransition\b" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head; grep -n "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts; grep -n "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts

cd /workspace; grep -n "ViewTransition:\|function ViewTransition\|const ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "\"version\"" node_modules/@types/react/package.json
cd /workspace; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json; git status --short; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace; cat .gitignore; (npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &); sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/; curl -s localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'Classic Sneakers\|skeleton-text large\|nav-back' | sort | uniq -c; pkill -f "next start"; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short
cd /workspace; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short
